about: Generic ClinForms outreach video (v1, fix pass of 10 Oct 2026) for owners and managers of UK private physiotherapy clinics: about 90 s, one fictional patient (Megan Hart, sim-pat-001) on one fictional referrer form (Harrow & Pike Medico-Legal (fictional), Word), the bundled Meridian sample for the upload-once step, and a montage of the five bundled fictional blank forms for the problem statement. Consumed by record-outreach.mjs (picture) and mix-outreach.mjs (narration, deliverables). 'lines' are the caption + voice-over pairs: one sentence each, caption max 2 lines of 42 characters; 'start' is the planned start in the FINAL cut (seconds), planned from the measured narration clips (each clip, then a 0.35-0.6 s pause), and 'end' is when the next line starts. 'shots' give the screen and the action order; the recorder schedules each action relative to its line's start, so a screen never changes before the line that belongs to the previous screen has finished. Server: the video worktree build on port 3310 in demo mode, so the drafts and the form reading are the prepared demo outputs: captions never say the drafting happens in real time and never show or claim a drafting time. Presentation-only changes made by the recorder (no app code is changed): the Studio footer (version string, sandbox link) is hidden; on 'Complete a form' the page intro and the 'Launch from the patient record' card are hidden, the simulated picker is labelled 'Clinic system (simulated)' and its label 'Simulated TM3 sandbox – demo data, not affiliated with TM3.' is kept, verbatim and larger; on the approved form the 'Completed form (PDF)' button (no Word-to-PDF converter on the live site) and 'Save to clinic record' (needs a live clinic-system connection) are hidden; the upload dialog's grid column is limited to the dialog width (long file names overflowed it). Framing rule: no legible 'TM3' text in a frame unless the label 'Simulated TM3 sandbox – demo data, not affiliated with TM3' is legible in the same frame. Never show the sixth sandbox patient (Rebecca Lane) or any screen that names a real insurer. Never click 'Completed form (PDF)' on the Harrow & Pike report.

shots.label: Title card
shots.action: Static title card (cards.title), fade in 0.35 s. No caption pill; the card carries the words.

shots.label: The problem: every referrer's own form
shots.setup: Before the take: page 1 of each bundled fictional blank form is rendered (Word via docx-preview, PDF via pdftoppm) into work/montage/. Inside a hard cut the tab opens montage.html.

actions.do: The five blank forms fly in one by one (0.35 s apart) into a fan, each with its referrer type and file type underneath: Harrow & Pike (medico-legal, Word), Northfield (insurer, fillable PDF), Kingsway (case manager, Word), Ashcroft (medico-legal, flat PDF), Meridian (insurer, Word).
The fan moves right and shrinks; a 'Clinic notes' card slides in on the left; one by one a 'same notes' chip flies to each form and an amber 'Typed again' badge lands on it.

shots.label: Upload their form once
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: the forms page, scrolled to the top, with the upload dialog open. The bundled Meridian sample is saved as Meridian-Claims_Physiotherapy-Discharge-Report_MCS-PDR-3.docx.

actions.do: Click the drop zone's button and choose the Meridian file (reading it is cut).
Type 'Meridian Claims Services (fictional)' into #upload-referrer; select type 'Insurer'.
Click 'Analyse form'; the prepared reading is cut, so the result appears as V04 ends.

shots.label: Questions found

actions.do: '17 questions found …' (the prepared demo reading is on screen for under a second); click 'Review the mapping' 0.75 s later.

checks: The summary count is read from the dialog, never typed into a caption.

shots.label: Where each answer goes
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: wait for the mapping page and its preview, scroll to the BOTTOM (sticky preview with one answer space highlighted). Do NOT expand a question: its source options name TM3.

actions.do: Cursor to the green-highlighted answer space in the preview.
Cursor to the 'Clinician opinion' chip of the long-term outcome question.
Cursor to the sticky 'Confirm mapping' button.

shots.label: Checked once by your team

actions.do: Click 'Confirm mapping'; type 'Sarah Reid'; tick the check box; rest on the description ('…completed this way for every patient … refers').
Click the dialog's 'Confirm mapping'; the page stays at the bottom (the footer stays below the fold).

checks: Do not scroll to the top banner after confirming: the stats card under it says 'TM3 registration'.

shots.label: Pick the patient
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: /reports/new; presentation-only: page intro and 'Launch from the patient record' hidden, the picker labelled 'Clinic system (simulated)', its label 'Simulated TM3 sandbox – demo data, not affiliated with TM3.' kept and enlarged.

actions.do: Hover 'Upload the notes – Available now…' (0.9 s), then click the search box and type 'Megan' (the list filters to Megan Hart).
Click 'Neck pain and headaches following road traffic accident'.

checks: Type the filter before anything else: the unfiltered list's last row names a real insurer and must never be on screen.

actions.do: Hover the Harrow & Pike card's 'Matches the referrer on the referral' chip, then click 'Complete this form' (drafting is cut).

shots.label: Filled in, in their own layout

actions.do: Top of the Harrow & Pike form with Part A filled; cursor points from the margin at 'Claimant name'; smooth scroll to 'B1. Mechanism of injury'.
Cursor along the first drafted paragraph to its 'Drafted from the notes' chip.
Click the citation 'N-001 · 18/03'; the note opens on the right; cursor to its text.

shots.label: A gap is flagged, not guessed

actions.do: Hover 'Needs clinician input' (…left blank rather than guessed).
Hover 'Gap – not in the record'.
Hover 'Only an opinion a clinician recorded, attributed to them…'.
Click the empty answer box (focus).
Her opinion is entered and committed inside a 0.3 s cut (while a paragraph is being typed the card shows a transient red 'Missing field' state); cursor clicks 'Mark resolved' on the gap.

shots.label: Approve – nothing is issued before
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: the remaining clinician answers, every item resolved ('16 of 16 answered and clear'), 'Approve…' opened, name, HCPC PH-DEMO-01 (fictional), typed signature, all attestations ticked.

actions.do: Cursor runs down the attestations.
Click 'Approve and sign'.

shots.label: Download their own file

actions.do: Hover and click 'Completed form (Word)'; toast 'Final document downloaded …_SIGNED.docx'.

checks: 'Completed form (PDF)' and 'Save to clinic record' are hidden (presentation only).
Punch-in to a 16:9 crop of the full content width; the F-01 card is pushed below the crop (its chips name TM3); toasts move into the crop.

shots.label: The final form, in their layout

actions.do: Top of the final form (no DRAFT mark), then a smooth scroll that ends with B7 (her words) and the signed Part C on screen and the page footer below the visible area.

shots.label: Portal answers

actions.do: Cursor to 'Copy answers · Approved', then along '…as plain text – for a portal, an e-mail or a letter'.
Cursor on 'Copy an answer, or all of them'; at 'or all at once' click 'Copy all answers'; toast '16 answers copied · The approved answers, ready to paste.'

checks: No answer cards on screen: their paragraph tags still read 'Draft' after approval.

shots.label: End card
shots.action: End card: the tagline from V18; the call to action (Book a 15-minute call · clinforms.co.uk · e-mail · Fictional patient data shown.) fades in as V19 starts. Fade out over the last 0.5 s.

teaser.captionStyle: Big caption, one or two lines, white on a dark pill, about 44 px at 800 px wide, centred in the lower third. Built from caption-free frames. The 'Fictional data' tag (large) sits top left on every app and montage segment. Frame 0 is the teaser title card, so an e-mail client that shows only the first frame shows a readable title and play badge.
